Investec Asset Management LTD Boosts Stake in Apple Inc. (AAPL) Posted by Caroline Horne | Mar 9th, 2018 
Investec Asset Management LTD grew its holdings in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 6.9% in the 3rd quarter, according to the company in its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The institutional investor owned 1,116,587 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after purchasing an additional 72,121 shares during the period. Investec Asset Management LTD’s holdings in Apple were worth $172,088,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. 
Other large investors have also bought and sold shares of the company. Gateway Advisory LLC boosted its holdings in shares of Apple by 72.6% in the second quarter. Gateway Advisory LLC now owns 2,860 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $412,000 after buying an additional 1,203 shares during the period. Univest Corp of Pennsylvania boosted its holdings in shares of Apple by 0.4% in the second quarter. Univest Corp of Pennsylvania now owns 33,479 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,822,000 after buying an additional 135 shares during the period. Markel Corp boosted its holdings in shares of Apple by 14.4% in the second quarter. Markel Corp now owns 103,100 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $14,848,000 after buying an additional 13,000 shares during the period. Parsec Financial Management Inc. boosted its holdings in shares of Apple by 0.3% in the second quarter. Parsec Financial Management Inc. now owns 283,170 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $40,782,000 after buying an additional 915 shares during the period. Finally, Hartford Financial Management Inc. boosted its holdings in shares of Apple by 12.5% in the second quarter. Hartford Financial Management Inc. now owns 11,308 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $1,628,000 after buying an additional 1,255 shares during the period. In other Apple news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of Apple stock in a transaction on Friday, January 5th. The shares were sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total transaction of $2,733,733.98. Following the sale, the insider now owns 13,739 shares in the company, valued at $2,401,302.42. The transaction was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which can be accessed through this link . 0.08% of the stock is owned by insiders. 
Shares of Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) opened at $176.94 on Friday. Apple Inc. has a 52 week low of $137.05 and a 52 week high of $180.62. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74, a quick ratio of 1.20 and a current ratio of 1.24. The firm has a market cap of $888,104.50, a price-to-earnings ratio of 17.99, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.32 and a beta of 1.19. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $87.62 billion. During the same quarter in the previous year, the company earned $3.36 earnings per share. The business’s revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. equities analysts forecast that Apple Inc. will post 11.43 EPS for the current fiscal year. 
The firm also recently declared a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, February 15th. Shareholders of record on Monday, February 12th were paid a dividend of $0.63 per share. The ex-dividend date of this dividend was Friday, February 9th. This represents a $2.52 dividend on an annualized basis and a yield of 1.42%. Apple’s dividend payout ratio is currently 25.90%. 
Several research analysts have commented on AAPL shares. UBS Group set a $190.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Tuesday, November 14th. Vetr upgraded shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $177.17 target price for the company in a report on Wednesday, November 29th. Nomura set a $185.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Monday, November 27th. Citigroup reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $200.00 target price on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, December 13th. Finally, KeyCorp reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $192.00 target price on shares of Apple in a report on Thursday, December 7th. One investment analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, eighteen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-two have assigned a buy rating and one has issued a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. Apple Profile 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
